analysis: The sampled-softmax trial succeeded operationally but did not improve macro validation HR@10: 0.5925 versus the supplied prior graph result of 0.595, a decrease of 0.0025. Category HR@10 was Movies_and_TV 0.660, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.605, Electronics 0.405, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.700. Electronics improved by 0.010 over its supplied prior 0.395, but remained below the supplied SASRec baseline of 0.420. The hypothesized macro gain of 0.005–0.015 was not observed. These results do not establish the proposed gradient explanation; only the ranking objective changed, and the observed aggregate effect was slightly negative.
code_summary: One independent LightGCN per category, with 64-dimensional embeddings, three normalized graph propagation layers, uniform averaging of initial and propagated embeddings, and a jointly learned item bias. Replaced pairwise softplus ranking loss with temperature-1 cross-entropy over one positive and eight sampled negatives; retained embedding and bias regularization. Training uses Adam at 0.003, batch size 2048, 20 steps per epoch, seed 42, up to 200 epochs, patience 35, and a 1800-second category cap. Training negatives exclude observed training items and may repeat. Validation selects one checkpoint per category by HR@10 with NDCG tie-breaking. Predictor routing loads exactly that single checkpoint for each category; no ensembles or separately fitted scorers are used.
